content.text: Selling digital products like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-sell-ebooks-kenya-everything-you-need-get-9|ebooks]], templates, and courses can be a challenge when platforms like PayPal and Stripe are restricted. In countries facing such limitations, creators often find themselves locked out of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-get-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-live|COREMERCH guide to payment]] processing. This is where Bitcoin [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-7|Tron USDT]] become a viable solution, allowing digital creators to sell directly to customers without relying on conventional payment platforms. This breakdown will explore how to set up a sovereign digital commerce stack to facilitate Bitcoin payments for digital downloads, ensuring creators retain control and maximize profit.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

The infrastructure for selling digital downloads using Bitcoin involves creating a sovereign stack that eliminates reliance on conventional payment systems. By leveraging low-cost and efficient tools, creators can establish their own payment processing methods that accept Bitcoin. This matters because it empowers creators to bypass high fees associated with platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale, compared to NOWPayments' mere 0.5%. With this structure, creators not only retain more profit but also enjoy complete ownership of their digital assets.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture involves several key components working seamlessly to facilitate transactions. First, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic, ensuring that payment processing is efficient and secure. Next, NOWPayments automatically verifies Bitcoin transactions, providing instant payment confirmation with minimal fees. For file delivery, services like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensure that digital products reach customers immediately upon payment. This combination allows for a robust infrastructure that manages everything from order storage via Supabase or Google Sheets to automated delivery, creating a streamlined experience for both creators and customers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or heavily restricted. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, or digital assets like templates and plugins, this setup empowers you to take charge of your sales process. It’s built for those who want to retain full control over their products and profits without the burden of high platform fees. Creators can finally sell directly to their audience, using Bitcoin as a universal payment method that transcends geographic limitations.
Retain 99.5% of your sales by using NOWPayments instead of high-fee platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereignty of this stack comes from its carefully selected components. You have GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, ensuring your digital storefront is accessible. The backend logic is powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, providing the necessary functionality without heavy costs. Order management is facilitated by Supabase or Google Sheets, while NOWPayments processes the transactions in over 300 cryptocurrencies with just a 0.5% fee. Each piece of this puzzle is designed to empower creators, minimizing reliance on third-party platforms while maximizing efficiency and profitability.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this architecture, start by selecting the stack that suits your needs. For a quick setup, the Sovereign Starter Stack is an excellent choice. Next, configure your hosting using GitHub Pages and connect it with Cloudflare Workers for payment processing. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions and set up your product delivery via Google Drive. Finally, ensure you have clear documentation and support in place. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit, which provides all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline the process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, utilize a sovereign digital commerce stack that integrates Bitcoin payments. This setup allows you to retain full control over your sales and avoid high fees from conventional platforms. It also enables immediate product delivery and transaction confirmation, creating a seamless experience for both you and your customers.
Instant product delivery ensures your customers receive their purchases immediately.

This package includes everything needed to build and deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure tailored for selling digital products using Bitcoin. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by selecting your preferred stack, such as the Sovereign Starter Stack. Set up your hosting through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Integrate backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Configure NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Prepare your product files in Google Drive for immediate delivery. Test the entire system to ensure functionality. Refer to the Complete Builder Kit for detailed blueprints and templates to facilitate your setup.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I start accepting Bitcoin for my digital downloads?

To accept Bitcoin, set up a sovereign digital commerce stack using tools like Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments. Ensure your products are hosted on GitHub Pages and configure automated delivery to customers upon payment confirmation.
What fees should I expect when using Bitcoin payments?
Using NOWPayments, you will incur a 0.5% transaction fee for Bitcoin payments. This is significantly lower than traditional platforms like Gumroad, which can charge up to 10% per sale.
Can I sell multiple products with this setup?
Yes, you can sell multiple products using this infrastructure. Depending on the selected stack, you can load several products and manage them efficiently through the backend.
Is it difficult to maintain my own digital store?
Maintaining your own digital store is manageable with the right tools and documentation. The Complete Builder Kit provides all necessary templates and guides to simplify the process.
What if I need help during setup?
You will receive 30 days of support after deploying your stack. Additionally, the Complete Builder Kit includes extensive documentation to assist with any questions you may encounter.
